He earned his Doctor of Dental Medicine from Tufts University in 2003 and completed his pediatric dentistry training at NYU, where he was co-Chief Resident. Dr. Chen also holds a Biology degree from the University of Rochester and a Master's in Public Health from New York Medical College. He teaches at the University of Washington and is part of the Central Washington Cleft Lip and Palate Team. 

His practice is located at 15446 Bel-Red Road, Suite 300, Redmond, WA 98052. You can contact the office at (425) 883-3399 or via email at scheduling@belredpediatrics.com.

12. Cavity Prevention 
13. Interceptive Orthodontics 
14. Dental Fillings and Crowns 
15. Mouthguards 
16. Impacted Supernumerary Teeth
